instruction.name: vfsub.s
instruction.description: Subtract corresponding single precision floating point elements in `b` from elements in `a`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 4.99; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
